title: Architecture design, review and survey
description: Fixes structural boundaries before planning (DESIGN.md at plan:pre) and checks they survived the implementation (ARCH-REVIEW.md at verify:pre). The design half feeds the contract-drift gate, which compares each declared signature against the code; without it that gate has nothing to read. At plan:post a blocking gate checks the design's mermaid diagrams: every identifier they draw is declared in the code or introduced by the design itself. The survey half (/gsd:arch-survey, run by a person or proposed at milestone close) looks for drift outside any phase's promises: `gsd-tools arch metrics` counts hot spots, coupling, cycles and co-change and splits the code into zones, one gsd-arch-surveyor per zone writes deepening candidates, gsd-finding-refuter (mode arch) tries to refute them, and every decision lands in .planning/architecture/DECISIONS.md so a rejected candidate is never proposed again.

workflow.architecture_design.description: Run the system architect before planning to produce DESIGN.md — layer placement, allowed dependencies, and the signatures that cross plan boundaries. Written at plan:pre because the planner's split of tasks across files IS the boundary decision; a design written afterwards narrates it instead of constraining it.

workflow.architecture_review.description: Run the architecture reviewer after execution to check the declared structure held: placements honoured, dependencies legal, no rejected alternative silently adopted. Distinct from gsd-verifier, which asks whether the goal was met rather than whether it was met where the design said.

workflow.architecture_diagrams_gate.description: Block planning when the phase DESIGN.md draws an identifier that exists nowhere — not declared in the code and not introduced by the design (gsd_run diagrams check). Ships off like the capability's other switches; turn it on together with workflow.architecture_design, which writes the DESIGN.md it checks. Deterministic: a declaration index of the project, not a model's judgement. It also blocks on a diagram whose names could not be checked — a block outside the subset, a state diagram without %% gsd:source, a derived block nothing can regenerate or that is stale; a name it cannot resolve for certain (ambiguous) is a warning, never a block.

architecture.survey_window.description: History window of an architecture survey: 90d, 12w, 6m, 1y, an ISO date, or a ref. Hot spots are churn x complexity over this window; a window with no readable commits falls back to complexity alone and the metrics say so.

architecture.survey_top_zones.description: Zones an architecture survey fans out over, one gsd-arch-surveyor each (1 to 50). The cost knob of /gsd:arch-survey.

architecture.small_module_loc.description: A module of at most this many non-blank lines counts as small for the survey's search signals (small-module clusters, pass-throughs). A signal for where to look, never a verdict.

architecture.cochange_min_support.description: Commits two files must share before the survey reports them as a co-change pair (inclusive).

architecture.cochange_min_confidence.description: Minimum co-change confidence, in (0, 1], inclusive: confidence(a->b) = shared commits / commits of a, and a pair is reported when the larger of its two confidences reaches this value.

architecture.survey_growth_threshold.description: Relative growth of a hot spot's score, compared with the last survey over the same scope, above which (strictly) arch metrics --compare-last reports growth. 0.25 = more than 25%.

architecture.metrics_at_milestone.description: Measure the architecture when a milestone closes (complete-milestone, milestone:post): gsd-tools arch stage runs arch metrics --compare-last over the configured scope and window and writes .planning/architecture/metrics-<date>.json, the baseline the next close compares against. Deterministic and model-free; whether a survey follows is architecture.survey_at_milestone's call. Off: nothing runs at the close.

architecture.survey_at_milestone.description: What complete-milestone does (after the architecture.metrics_at_milestone measurement) when hot spots grew past architecture.survey_growth_threshold, entered the hot spot list, or a new import cycle appeared since the last survey: suggest (name /gsd:arch-survey and the zones), auto (run it), off. No growth, no prompt.
